# FLAC decoder

`flac-decoder-0.2.11.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of
`@wasm-audio-decoders/flac` 0.2.11, retrieved from the npm registry.
Copyright 2021–2026 Ethan Halsall. Package license: MIT.
Source: https://github.com/eshaz/wasm-audio-decoders/tree/main/src/flac

The bundle includes libFLAC (BSD-3-Clause), codec-parser (MIT), and supporting
WASM decoder code. Upstream notices are retained in the distributed source.
